question.text: A particle of charge <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>q</mi></math> and mass <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>m</mi></math> is moving with a velocity <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>-</mo><mi>v</mi><mover><mi>i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo>≠</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>)</mo></math> towards a large screen placed in the <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Y</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>Z</mi></math> plane at distance d. If there is magnetic field <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>B</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>B</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mover><mi>k</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>,</mo></math> the minimum value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>v</mi></math> for which the particle will not hit the screen is :

solution.text:
The radius of circular path in given magnetic field is

r=d=mvqB0

so v=qB0dm
